how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-blackrock-depths-01-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:3801:obj:0: Speak with ⟦E1⟧ if you are interested in obtaining a key to the city major.
rows.quest:3801:details:0: Greetings, ⟦1⟧. I am ⟦E1⟧. Yes, the ⟦E1⟧ responsible for the stonewrought method of architecture. You have undoubtedly passed through or stood upon one of my creations in your adventures across our war torn world.
rows.quest:3801:details:1: You are probably wondering why I am here and what it is that I want from you - both valid questions.
rows.quest:3801:details:2: I need your assistance, of course. In exchange for your assistance, I shall grant you the key to the depths of my accursed city.
rows.quest:3801:completion:0: Whether it is greed which brought you here or an act of selfless devotion, what you are about to undertake is for the good of us all.
rows.quest:3802:obj:0: Slay ⟦E2⟧ and recover the great hammer, ⟦E3⟧. Take ⟦E3⟧ to the Shrine of Thaurissan and place it on the statue of ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:3802:details:0: You will find ⟦E2⟧ beyond the Ring of Law, in the Hall of Crafting. Kill the miserable cur and recover ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:3802:details:1: Take ⟦E3⟧ to the Shrine of Thaurissan and place the hammer in its rightful place: In the hands of the statue erected in my honor.
rows.quest:3802:details:2: When this is done, the compartment in which I stored the ⟦E4⟧ will open. More importantly, ⟦E3⟧ will remain forever in my grasp. Should they make an attempt to remove the hammer; both the statue and hammer will shatter, lost forever.
rows.quest:3802:progress:0: The statue looms ominously above you.
rows.quest:3802:completion:0: The hammer slides firmly into place, within the grasp of the massive Dark Iron monument. A tiny compartment opens at the base of the statue. Inside you find...
rows.quest:3981:obj:1: You recall that the crudely drawn picture of the orc included bars drawn over the portrait. Perhaps you should search for a prison of some sort.
rows.quest:3981:details:0: Poor Gargal... didn't even see it coming. WHAM! The arrow landed dead center on the top of his head. He was no genius before but now...
rows.quest:3981:details:2: When we dislodged the arrow, we noticed a rolled up note attached to the shaft. On the note was a crudely drawn picture of an orc behind bars with the signature of ⟦E5⟧ attached.
rows.quest:3981:details:3: If he's still alive in the Depths, you'll have to find him.
rows.quest:3981:details:4: BA trap you say? Well no kidding, numb hooves! That's why you're going!⟦2⟧
rows.quest:3981:completion:0: We haven't got much time. Listen carefully, ⟦3⟧. What I have to tell you is classified and for your ears only.
rows.quest:4081:obj:0: Venture to ⟦E6⟧ and destroy the vile aggressors!
rows.quest:4081:obj:1: ⟦E7⟧ wants you to kill 15 Anvilrage Guardsmen, 10 Anvilrage Wardens and 5 Anvilrage Footmen. Return to him once your task is complete.
rows.quest:4081:details:0: By order of ⟦E7⟧, commander of the Kargath Expeditionary Force:
rows.quest:4081:details:1: Any and all of ⟦E8⟧'s forces within ⟦E6⟧ must be annihilated.
rows.quest:4081:details:2: Angerforge's men are ruthless killers, responsible for the mass murder of the 109th division of the Kargath Expeditionary Force. Heroes are warned to exercise extreme caution when confronting these brutes.
rows.quest:4081:details:3: Any person who destroys the first line of ⟦E8⟧'s forces in ⟦E6⟧ shall receive a tribute.
rows.quest:4081:progress:0: What is it, ⟦4⟧? Can't you see I have a platoon to command?⟦5⟧⟦6⟧
rows.quest:4081:completion:0: This first strike should put a crease in Angerforge's pants. Now, move along soldier. I have work to complete, battles to plan, enemies to crush!
rows.quest:4081:completion:1: Check the wanted signs for more work.
rows.quest:4136:details:0: My brother Ribbly has always been a drain to his family, taking our money and wasting it on one scheme after another.
rows.quest:4136:details:1: Well, his last scheme must have been his worst, because ⟦E14⟧ of ⟦E15⟧ just put a price on poor Ribbly's head. I can't tell you how happy this makes the Screwspigots! Our little Ribbly's finally worth something!
rows.quest:4136:details:2: But now he's hiding out, deep in ⟦E6⟧. Please, find him and bring him to me!
rows.quest:4136:details:3: Or, if he won't come, then that's ok... just bring me his head.
rows.quest:4136:progress:0: Do you have Ribbly?  Or, at least a part of him?
rows.quest:4136:completion:0: Aha! You found him! And... it appears that my little brother didn't want to come quiety. It's a pity. I would have liked to see the look on his face when I told him our plans to turn him in to Revilgaz.
rows.quest:4136:completion:1: Thank you, ⟦7⟧. You've made my family very happy. And Ribbly's never looked as peaceful as he does now.
rows.quest:4324:details:0: Although my little brother Ribbly has been worthless his whole life, I think, finally, he has some value! But... we might need your help to capitalize on Ribbly's newfound worth.
rows.quest:4324:details:1: My sister Yuka has been looking for him for weeks, and tracked him to the ⟦E13⟧. She sent word to me, asking for some hired hands.
rows.quest:4324:details:2: So, what do you say? Want to help? If so, then speak with my sister. You'll find her holed up in Flame Crest, a cave northwest of ⟦E16⟧.
rows.quest:4324:completion:0: Yes, I'm looking for my brother. We must find him and retrieve him, bless his heart.
rows.quest:4324:completion:1: But if we can't bring all of him... then his head will suffice.
rows.quest:3982:details:0: I was sent here under the auspices of ⟦E17⟧. Do you actually think these buffoons could capture me? I allowed myself to be captured so that I could gather intelligence.
rows.quest:3982:details:2: The ⟦E18⟧ of ⟦E19⟧ has been kidnapped by Emperor Thaurissan. ⟦E18⟧ Bronzebeard is in this very city! I bet old Magni's heart almost stopped when he heard that news.
rows.quest:3982:details:4: Shhh! Do you hear that? Guards coming! DEFEND YOURSELF!
rows.quest:3982:completion:0: That was a close call. They have been alerted to your presence... more will surely come.
rows.quest:4001:obj:0: Speak with ⟦E20⟧ and gather information about ⟦E21⟧'s kidnapping. Take that information to ⟦E17⟧ in ⟦E22⟧.
rows.quest:4001:obj:1: You recall Gor'shak mentioning that Kharan is being held in a cell nearby.⟦8⟧
rows.quest:4001:details:0: So far, my communication with the dwarf, Kharan, in the cell across the hall, has been limited. I have, however, managed to convince him that I, rather -we- mean him no harm.
rows.quest:4001:details:1: Go speak with him and gather as much information about the ⟦E18⟧ and her captors as possible. Take that information back to the Warchief.
rows.quest:4001:details:2: ⟦E17⟧ does not want the ⟦E18⟧ harmed, but instead, has some grand plan laid out, which includes her being safely returned to ⟦E19⟧. Kharan already knows all of this... Go!⟦9⟧
rows.quest:4001:progress:0: What brings you to these hallowed grounds?
rows.quest:4001:completion:0: This is a chance for the ⟦E25⟧ to change the political climate of our war torn world forever. Listen carefully, ⟦10⟧.
rows.quest:4001:completion:1: Failure of this mission is not an option.
rows.quest:4002:obj:0: Speak with ⟦E17⟧ if you are prepared to take on the mission he has planned.
rows.quest:4002:details:1: As Warchief, it is my duty to do what is best for the ⟦E25⟧. To ensure that the generations that come after us are not forced into a hopeless existence.
rows.quest:4002:details:2: The opportunity to shape our future alliances has fallen into our collective laps. A move to help the dwarves could greatly strengthen our relationships in the ⟦E26⟧. This, then, is why you must not fail!
rows.quest:4002:completion:0: There is no going back beyond this point, ⟦12⟧.
rows.quest:4082:obj:0: Venture to ⟦E6⟧ and destroy the vile aggressors!
rows.quest:4082:obj:1: ⟦E7⟧ wants you to kill 10 Anvilrage Medics, 10 Anvilrage Soldiers and 10 Anvilrage Officers. Return to him once your task is complete.
rows.quest:4082:details:0: By order of ⟦E7⟧, commander of the Kargath Expeditionary Force:
rows.quest:4082:details:1: Head of the K.E.F. reconnaissance division, Grandmaster ⟦E28⟧, has returned with news of the whereabouts of high ranking Dark Iron officials. Through locked gate, near the heart of the city, they train their forces to snuff out our men. ⟦E29⟧ to ⟦E6⟧ and destroy them!
rows.quest:4082:details:2: Completion of this mission will result in a tribute.⟦13⟧
rows.quest:4082:progress:0: You again? I have to hand it to you, ⟦14⟧, you are tenacious.
rows.quest:4082:completion:0: Angerforge is undoubtedly... angry. Return to me when you receive a third tribute and we shall proceed with ⟦E30⟧. I cannot go into any detail of what this entails, but rest assured, it involves somebody dying.
rows.quest:4201:obj:0: Bring 4 ⟦E31⟧, 10 Giant Silver Veins and ⟦E32⟧ to ⟦E33⟧ in ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:4201:details:0: Oh, the pains of love! My dear ⟦E34⟧ is immune to my charms. I am spurned! It's maddening!
rows.quest:4201:details:1: You must help me! We succubi know much of love, and I can make a potion to beat down the iron walls around Rocknot's heart. To make it, I need these items: the herb gromsblood, giant silver veins from the cliff giants of ⟦E37⟧, and water from the Golakka Springs Crater in Un'Goro. You can place the water in this vial.
rows.quest:4201:details:2: Please, ⟦15⟧, help a poor soul in her quest for happiness!
rows.quest:4201:progress:0: Do you have the ingredients?  The hole in my heart threatens to consume me!
rows.quest:4201:completion:0: Oh, you've done it! I can now make my potion and use it on Rocknot. Finally, he will fall victim to my charms!
rows.quest:4201:completion:1: Thank you, ⟦16⟧. You are a champion of love!
rows.quest:4241:obj:0: ⟦E29⟧ to ⟦E38⟧ in the northwest and enter ⟦E6⟧. Find out what became of ⟦E39⟧.
rows.quest:4241:obj:1: You recall ⟦E40⟧ talking about Windsor being dragged off to a prison.
rows.quest:4241:details:0: So that good for nothing coward says that Windsor is alive, eh?
rows.quest:4241:details:1: Suit up, deputy, you are going in to find him. If Windsor is alive, you are to bring him back. If he's dead, I want proof.
rows.quest:4241:details:3: I bet you are getting tired of hearing that, aren't you?
rows.quest:4241:completion:0: Where is he! I'll murder him!
rows.quest:4242:details:0: Bolvar is a fool. I was gathering his precious 'proof' so that I could shove it down his throat.
rows.quest:4242:details:1: He is a blind buffoon. Proof stands two feet away from him and he does not see.
rows.quest:4242:details:2: As for my data, it's lost. Gone. Unrecoverable.
rows.quest:4242:details:3: Should I ever find ⟦E42⟧ and make it out of this labyrinth, my first stop will be ⟦E43⟧, to place my hammer in between that reptile's eyes.
rows.quest:4242:completion:1: B<Maxwell lowers his head in mourning.>
rows.quest:4242:completion:2: It is unfortunate that a once proud and noble warrior would be turned into a blithering head case. I GUESS we've reached a dead end...
rows.quest:4242:completion:3: I must reward you for your efforts thus far, ⟦18⟧.
rows.quest:7201:obj:0: ⟦E29⟧ to ⟦E6⟧ and recover 10 ⟦E44⟧. Your first inclination is to search the golems and golem makers. You remember ⟦E45⟧ also muttering something about elementals.⟦19⟧
rows.quest:7201:details:0: There is work to be had for those venturing into the depths, ⟦20⟧.
rows.quest:7201:details:1: The Dark Irons have mastered creation of extremely powerful golems.
rows.quest:7201:details:2: Initial reports from our spies indicate that the dwarves use a unique power source to give their creations incomparable killing power.
rows.quest:7201:details:3: Just imagine what we could do with our abominations if we could get our hands on this essence of the elements! Turn that city upside down if you must, but do not return until you have found the essence! Payment will be worth the risk.
rows.quest:7201:completion:0: Wonderful! I will have these sent by courier to the ⟦E46⟧ at once!
rows.quest:7201:completion:1: As for you - here is payment, as promised. Keep the change, you filthy beast!
rows.quest:4083:progress:0: The gems make no sound as they fall into depths of the chalice...
rows.quest:4083:completion:0: The spectral chalice floats in the air, slowing rising and falling... as if to the beat of a dying heart.
rows.quest:4123:obj:0: Bring the Heart of the Mountain to ⟦E47⟧ in the ⟦E13⟧.
rows.quest:4123:details:0: For years I have sought a certain gem. It is called the Heart of the Mountain and it's the size of your fist! The Dark Iron dwarves have it locked in their vault and, try as I may, they won't let me purchase it.
rows.quest:4123:details:1: So I must resort to force.
rows.quest:4123:details:2: Fight your way to the Lower Vault of ⟦E6⟧, breach its secret safe and gain the Heart. To do that, you must defeat Watchman Doomgrip, and he won't appear until you've opened every relic coffer in the vault!
rows.quest:4123:progress:0: Do you have the Heart of the Mountain?  To me, its value is without limit.
rows.quest:4123:completion:0: You have the heart! Amazing! It is even more beautiful than I imagined!
rows.quest:4126:details:0: The Dark Iron dwarves, led by the villain ⟦E50⟧, stole one of the Thunderbrew's best recipes, Thunderbrew Lager. The villains! They don't deserve such a fine brew!
rows.quest:4126:details:1: B⟦22⟧, I have a tough task for you. Go to the ⟦E6⟧ in the ⟦E13⟧, destroy any kegs of Thunderbrew Lager you find, and bring back our recipe for Thunderbrew Lager!
rows.quest:4126:details:2: Please, get that recipe back, even if you have to turn ⟦E6⟧ upside down to do it!
rows.quest:4126:progress:0: Do you have the recipe, ⟦23⟧? I can't stand the idea of those Dark Iron dwarves drinking my family's drink!
rows.quest:4126:completion:0: You found it! Well done! And I hope you gave those Dark Irons, and ⟦E50⟧, a good thumping!
rows.quest:4126:completion:1: The Thunderbrews are at your service, ⟦24⟧. You are a hero of heroes!
rows.quest:4128:details:0: Ho, ⟦25⟧. I heard that ⟦E49⟧ is steaming mad about someone stealing his ale. He's looking for stalwart adventurers, and willing to pay plenty.
rows.quest:4128:details:1: Talk to Ragnar if you're interested. He's at the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, in ⟦E51⟧.
rows.quest:4128:completion:0: You're right I'm mad! I've been robbed! Robbed of one of our family recipes! How dare they! As if I didn't have enough cause to hate the Dark Iron dwarves! Now, oh... now they're in for it!
rows.quest:4133:details:0: Shadowmaster ⟦E45⟧ is in need of your services. She is in the ⟦E52⟧, in the orcish outpost of Kargath, pursuing rumors of a certain brew made by the Dark Iron dwarves of ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:4133:details:1: Speak with Vivian. She awaits you.
rows.quest:4133:completion:0: Thank you for coming, ⟦26⟧. This place is not without a stark charm, but is lacks the amenities of the Apothecarium.
rows.quest:4133:completion:1: Enough with the pleasantries. To business, yes?
rows.quest:4134:details:0: It is rumored that the Dark Iron ⟦E50⟧ has stolen a recipe for ale. This ale, Thunderbrew Lager, is said to infuse its imbiber with great strength and courage. We wish to study the drink. Perhaps, we will find other applications for its virtues... applications more in line with ⟦E53⟧ objectives.
rows.quest:4134:details:1: Delve into ⟦E6⟧, find Hurley, take from him the recipe for Thunderbrew lager and bring it to me.
rows.quest:4134:details:2: And to find him, you may have to entice him by threatening his precious ale.
rows.quest:4134:progress:0: Do you have the recipe for the Thunderbrew Lager, ⟦27⟧?
rows.quest:4134:completion:0: Very good. I will send this recipe to the Apothecarium to be studied, and in time we will unlock its secrets. One day, the dwarves of the ⟦E54⟧ may find the virtues of this drink used against them!
rows.quest:4134:completion:1: I find that terribly amusing. Perhaps death has an affect on one's sense of humor... do you think?
rows.quest:3907:obj:0: Enter ⟦E6⟧ and track down ⟦E55⟧. Slay him and return any source of information you may find to ⟦E56⟧.⟦28⟧
rows.quest:3907:details:0: I can taste the foulness in the air that surrounds you, ⟦29⟧. There is another, hidden in the depths of Blackrock, who does control this foulness.
rows.quest:3907:details:1: The wind and earth cry his name: ⟦E55⟧... but someone... something... commands this being. He is merely an emissary.
rows.quest:3907:details:2: Find him and discover where his master hides. Return to me when you have collected this information.⟦30⟧
rows.quest:3907:progress:0: The flames will soon overtake these lands. Make haste, ⟦31⟧!⟦32⟧⟦33⟧
rows.quest:3907:completion:2: The elders were right to fear the corruption emanating from ⟦E38⟧. A general of the Old Gods! IN OUR WORLD! We must reassess our position here in Kargath. We must decide on whether we stay and fight or run for fear of a new sundering.
rows.quest:3907:completion:3: Be weary of any further exploration in ⟦E38⟧, ⟦34⟧. A far greater evil than anything that exists in this world resides in those fiery depths.
rows.quest:4263:details:0: Are you sure Pyron said 'Incendius' when he died?
rows.quest:4263:details:2: ⟦E55⟧ is purported to be a minion of Ragnaros! Oh dear, oh dear... whatever will we do?
rows.quest:4263:details:3: Do you think you can handle another mission? I don't have anybody else to send, ⟦35⟧!
rows.quest:4263:details:4: We will never get a team in if Incendius continues to raise Pyron from the ashes.
rows.quest:4263:details:5: You'll have to find and destroy ⟦E55⟧!⟦36⟧
rows.quest:4263:completion:0: Oh dear! Are you sure Incendius said 'Ragnaros?'
rows.quest:4263:completion:1: B<Jalinda hands you something and pats you on the wrist as she fades deep into thought.>
rows.quest:4286:obj:0: ⟦E29⟧ to ⟦E6⟧ and recover 20 Dark Iron Fanny Packs. Return to ⟦E59⟧ when you have completed this task. You assume that the Dark Iron dwarves inside ⟦E6⟧ carry these 'fanny pack' contraptions.⟦37⟧
rows.quest:4286:details:0: Captain Winky tells me that the Dark Irons in the Depths got all the good stuff. Ain't that right, Winky?
rows.quest:4286:details:1: B<⟦E59⟧ does his best impersonation of a pirate.>
rows.quest:4286:details:3: See what I'm saying? You need to get in there and bring me back some samples of the good stuff.
rows.quest:4286:details:4: Get in there and shake your moneymaker!⟦38⟧
rows.quest:4286:progress:0: I can't be bothered right now, ⟦39⟧. Me and Winky got a meeting to attend.
rows.quest:4286:completion:0: <⟦E59⟧ starts rummaging through the mountainous pile of fanny packs.>
rows.quest:4286:completion:2: B<⟦E59⟧ sticks his large nose into the pile and takes a whiff.>
rows.quest:4286:completion:3: BDELICIOUS! Look at all these goodies!
rows.quest:4286:completion:4: Take one for yourself, ⟦40⟧. There's plenty to go around.
rows.quest:4024:obj:1: You only know that the giant resides inside ⟦E6⟧. Remember to use the ⟦E61⟧ on ⟦E60⟧'s remains to capture the Fiery Essence.
rows.quest:4024:details:0: I wish to taste the searing flames of the mountain of fire. To let the molten fires of Blackrock cascade across my being. That essence, that searing heat, it is what I crave.
rows.quest:4024:details:1: ⟦E60⟧ resides in the Depths of Blackrock: A being of pure flame, born of the fires of Ragnaros. Slay ⟦E60⟧ and from his smoldering remains bring for me a piece of his inner fire.
rows.quest:4024:details:2: Use the molt on his remains to safely extract the inner flame.
rows.quest:4024:completion:0: <Cyrus snatches the fiery essence from your hands.>
rows.quest:4024:completion:2: Take your prize and be gone. Leave my sight at once!
rows.quest:4063:obj:0: Find and slay Golem Lord Argelmach. Return his head to Lotwil. You will also need to collect 10 Intact ⟦E65⟧ Cores from the Ragereaver Golems and Warbringer Constructs protecting Argelmach. You know this because you are psychic.
rows.quest:4063:details:0: This can't be Argelmach! Argelmach was killed ten years ago. How can I be sure? I was the one who killed him.
rows.quest:4063:details:1: He was a despicable dwarf, hell-bent on twisting my life's work to meet his diabolical needs. It seems that the wicked always find a way to escape justice.
rows.quest:4063:details:2: If this is Argelmach's handiwork then he must be destroyed. I will need samplings of his latest creations. With the proper samples, I may be able to stop this uprising. The creations guard Argelmach in ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:4063:progress:0: Was it him? Was he really alive?
rows.quest:4063:completion:0: What is this?!? This head is not flesh. This is some sort of dark iron creation: A shadow of Argelmach - ANOTHER machine! I suspect that your destruction of Argelmach will be short lived as another shall rise to take 'its' place soon.
rows.quest:4121:obj:0: Escort your prisoner, ⟦E66⟧, through ⟦E13⟧ and through ⟦E38⟧ to the ⟦E67⟧.
rows.quest:4121:obj:1: You recall ⟦E28⟧ mentioning that he would have his men waiting on the other side to take Grark into custody.
rows.quest:4121:obj:2: You will also be required to hand over your ⟦E68⟧ to ⟦E28⟧.
rows.quest:4121:details:0: Do you truly believe that you will make it to your rendezvous point with me in custody? You actually expected to break into a heavily fortified Blackrock fortress to capture a prized asset of theirs without alerting anyone or anything to your presence?
rows.quest:4121:progress:0: I will take this traitorous filth, ⟦42⟧.
rows.quest:4121:completion:0: Your heroics will not go unrecognized, ⟦43⟧. You have earned this tribute. The Warlord will speak with you now in regards to the final mission.
rows.quest:4122:obj:0: ⟦E29⟧ to the ⟦E13⟧ and find ⟦E66⟧. You recall ⟦E28⟧ mentioning that he was last seen in a massive Blackrock fortress.
rows.quest:4122:obj:1: When you find ⟦E66⟧, use the ⟦E68⟧ to bind him and then lead him back through ⟦E38⟧ to the ⟦E67⟧. ⟦E28⟧ will have his men waiting on the other side to take Grark into custody.⟦44⟧
rows.quest:4122:details:0: I tracked him across the ⟦E67⟧, through the mountain, and into the ⟦E13⟧. That traitor was caught red-handed giving the Blackrock orcs vital information about our day to day operations. I'm speaking of ⟦E66⟧.
rows.quest:4122:details:1: He now sits in the ⟦E13⟧, safely under their protection - or so he thinks.
rows.quest:4122:details:2: Take these shackles, ⟦45⟧. Find Grark, place the shackles on him and lead him through ⟦E38⟧. Do this and a tribute is yours.⟦46⟧
rows.quest:4122:completion:0: Can you not see the power we gain by joining the legion of Blackrock?
rows.quest:4132:obj:0: ⟦E29⟧ to ⟦E6⟧ and slay ⟦E8⟧! Return to ⟦E7⟧ when the task is complete.
rows.quest:4132:details:0: You have done an exemplary job, ⟦47⟧. It is now time to send you on your last mission.
rows.quest:4132:details:1: ⟦E8⟧, the Dark Iron responsible for coordinating the attacks on the 109th division of the K.E.F. and the mass slaughter of our forces must be brought to justice.
rows.quest:4132:details:2: This will undoubtedly be your most grueling mission, but should you succeed, you will be richly rewarded.⟦48⟧
rows.quest:4132:progress:0: Has the Butcher of Blackrock been disposed of?
rows.quest:4132:completion:0: Finally! The villain been brought to justice! You are a remarkable individual, ⟦49⟧. Wear this medallion as a symbol of your stalwart dedication to the ⟦E25⟧ and the K.E.F.
rows.quest:4264:obj:0: You may have just stumbled on to something that ⟦E39⟧ would be interested in seeing. There may be hope, after all.
rows.quest:4264:details:0: The note has stains covering its surface. The text is barely legible, but you make out the following:
rows.quest:4264:details:3: B...if it were not for ⟦E8⟧'s diligence, we may have never discovered the pattern to the encryption...
rows.quest:4264:details:4: B...Argelmach is almost done with the decryption of Windsor's notes.
rows.quest:4264:details:5: Our lord will rise from the depths and crush any that remain...
rows.quest:4264:progress:0: <⟦E39⟧ eyes the note in your hand.>⟦51⟧⟦52⟧What do you have there, ⟦53⟧?
rows.quest:4264:completion:0: <⟦E39⟧ takes the note and begins reading.>
rows.quest:4282:obj:1: ⟦E39⟧ believes that the information is being held by Golem Lord Argelmach and ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:4282:details:1: Do you realize what this means, ⟦54⟧?
rows.quest:4282:details:2: Perhaps all is not lost! From what I can ascertain, the information is being held by two Dark Iron dwarves: ⟦E8⟧ and the golem lord, Argelmach. I have a feeling that they won't just hand over the information if we ask nicely.
rows.quest:4282:details:3: I hope you are ready to battle.
rows.quest:4282:details:4: Venture forth and find these two villains! Destroy them and return my lost information.
rows.quest:4282:progress:0: Soon this grand subterfuge will be over.
rows.quest:4282:completion:0: <⟦E39⟧ snatches the two tablets from your hands.>
rows.quest:4282:completion:1: We need to get out of here!
